title: Lunar: Silver Star Story Complete
native_title: ルナ ～シルバー・スター・ストーリー～ ＭＰＥＧ版
overview:
All anime scenes completely renewed! The complete edition in full screen and high quality!!

- All 50 minutes of anime scenes converted to MPEG
- New items added, powering up the main game as well
- Comes with premium trading cards

A boy from a small country village dreams of becoming an adventurer and of following in the footsteps of the legendary Dragonmaster. Setting out on a journey, he must face the trials of the ancient dragons while a powerful sorcerer schemes to take control of the world.

This role-playing game has no random encounters - enemies are visible on the map, and battles begin when you touch them. In battle, move your characters around the field, attack enemies in range, cast magic, use items or let the auto-battle option take over.

- 1 player
- Requires the Movie Card or Twin Operator on Sega Saturn and V-Saturn; plays on Hi-Saturn alone

アニメシーンを全て刷新！
